title: Senior Product Manager - Presales
description:
**This role is for one of Weekday's clients
   

  

 Salary range: Rs 1800000 \- Rs 3500000 (ie INR 18 \- 35 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 5\+ years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and analytical
 **Senior Product Manager \- Presales** 
 to lead product initiatives that improve the lead\-to\-sales conversion journey. This is a hands\-on, outcome\-driven role focused on building scalable systems and workflows that help convert qualified customer interest into scheduled and completed sales interactions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong product management experience in conversion\-focused domains such as lead management, inside sales systems, CRM platforms, growth infrastructure, or workflow automation. You will work closely with Business, Sales, Engineering, Data, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, improve decision\-making, and build technology solutions that enhance conversion efficiency and team productivity.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own and drive product initiatives across presales and lead\-conversion systems, including lead scoring, prioritization, workflow management, intervention orchestration, and funnel analytics
* Develop and enhance lead scoring capabilities by identifying meaningful conversion signals and translating data insights into actionable prioritization models
* Work closely with Data and Engineering teams to design real\-time or near\-real\-time systems that support effective lead prioritization
* Define and improve intervention strategies to determine the appropriate timing, communication channel, and engagement approach for prospective customers
* Optimize workflows used by presales and lead management teams to improve productivity, reduce manual effort, and minimize operational inefficiencies
* Analyze existing CRM systems and workflows, identify gaps and limitations, and drive redesign or enhancement initiatives to support evolving business requirements
* Improve the end\-to\-end lead\-to\-visit journey by identifying recurring bottlenecks, rework, escalations, and conversion drop\-offs
* Define product priorities based on business impact, conversion opportunities, operational efficiency, and scalability
* Lead the complete product lifecycle, including problem discovery, requirement definition, solution design, execution, launch, performance analysis, and continuous iteration
* Partner with Sales, Business, Engineering, and Data teams to balance immediate business needs with long\-term platform improvements
* Define key product metrics, funnel metrics, and instrumentation requirements to measure product performance and conversion outcomes
* Drive automation opportunities across presales workflows to create scalable and efficient processes
* Support and mentor Product Managers by improving problem\-solving approaches, product thinking, decision\-making, and execution quality
* Influence senior stakeholders through clear communication, data\-driven insights, and strong product judgment


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* 5\-10 years of experience in Product Management, preferably within presales systems, inside sales platforms, lead management, CRM, growth products, or conversion\-focused environments
* Strong experience working with data and analytics to understand customer behavior, conversion funnels, and product performance
* Proven understanding of lead scoring and prioritization, including the ability to identify predictive signals and differentiate meaningful insights from noise
* Experience defining product requirements and working closely with Engineering and Data teams to build scalable solutions
* Strong understanding of CRM systems, workflow automation, and business process optimization
* Ability to independently structure ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear product solutions
* Experience managing multiple interconnected product areas and balancing competing priorities
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior business and technology leaders
* Demonstrated experience in end\-to\-end product ownership, from discovery through execution and post\-launch optimization


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building or managing AI\-driven product features such as voicebots, recommendation engines, automated workflows, or intelligent intervention systems
* Experience with lead scoring and prioritization models
* Strong background in product analytics and conversion funnel optimization
* Experience working with inside sales, customer engagement, or high\-volume lead management platforms
* Familiarity with automation and AI\-powered decision\-making systems
* Experience mentoring Product Managers or leading product initiatives across multiple teams


 Key Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Product Management
* AI Product Experience
* Lead Scoring and Prioritization
* CRM and Workflow Management
* Product Analytics
* Conversion Funnel Optimization
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Workflow Automation
* Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Problem Solving
* Strategic Product Thinking


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* AI Product Experience
* Lead Scoring
* CRM / Workflow Management


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Lead Scoring and Prioritization
* AI\-Driven Product Features
* Strong Product Analytics
* Inside Sales Systems
* Workflow Automation

title: SOLUTION MANAGER - PRESALES L4
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
**Role Purpose** 




  

 The purpose of this role is to help build pipeline by effectively understanding client requirements and liaising with internal functions/stakeholders to prepare a winning solution by leveraging the capabilities within D\&OP for the client. 
   

  
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 



* **Prepare a winning solution for the fulfill the requirements of the client** 
	+ Requirement Understanding, Data Gathering \& Solution Design
		- Engage with the customers, understand and interpret their needs correctly, and churn out a proposal with a solution that is aligned with the customers' demands/requirements
		- Engage with clients or sales team to understand the purpose of the proposal, the requirements and expectations of the client
		- Lead and prepare the RFP/RFI/RFQ responses and presentations. Write, edit and finalize each section of a proposal, ensuring the content matches the RFP
		- Ensure RFP instructions pertaining to format, fonts, page limits, etc. are being followed along with internal branding guidelines
		- Performs final electronic layout and formatting as well as production of hard copies as required
		- Follow up with sales team post submission of RFP response
	+ Co\-ordination and Support to Internal Teams
		- Coordinates with partners to request and collect relevant data and inputs or other narratives to respond to proposal requirements
		- Work with sales team proactively and provide support for 2nd and 3rd level customer meetings.
		- Prepare a list of questions and of information/material needed to create the proposal
		- Include standard or approved proposal language for legal sections according to company policy
		- Write the proposal and/or coordinate with team members to ensure each section is written in a consistent format and completed according to the RFP instructions
		- Work with internal marketing team and external vendors for the purpose of proposal creation
		- Support the marketing team and create specific client dockets, collaterals, mailers etc.
		- Support the demand generating team of the marketing department by providing them lists of the accounts, stakeholders etc. that can be targeted


 ͏
 * **Effective Project Management** 
	+ Effectively and efficiently plan, organize, lead and control the delivery of the final solution/proposal/document
	+ Prepare a work plan that lists the tasks required to create the proposal, such as design, writing, editing, review and production
	+ Uses strong interpersonal, organizational, and time management skills to juggle multiple tasks with differing deadlines to consistently produce the document
	+ Collaborate and influence internal key stakeholders to get relevant data within the specified timeline to ensure relevant data in plugged into the solution
	+ Ensure promptness and compliance of proposals by creating and managing proposal calendars, compliance checklists, compliance matrices, trackers, etc.
	+ Oversees collection and completion of all proposal components (technical, cost, management, annexes) working in collaboration with internal teams, as well as partners.
	+ Follow up with relevant stakeholders/teams to get feedback and revisions and ensure that the proposal development stays on schedule.

* Support and drive Dealer \& Distributor A\&I team capability improvement through Distributor Excellence review, responding to A\&I technical queries.

* Effective Communication: Clearly understand customers’ technical requirements, effectively feedback to product group and seek for solutions. Have the courage to manage tough conversations with customers.
* Problem Solving: Uses varying problem\-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate to resolve customer issues during A\&I phase.
* Project Management: Be able to manage project timeline, identify risks and develop risk mitigation plan, ensure project to be delivered to quality and in time.


**Required Qualifications**
* Competent in use of Standard business tools including, Excel, Power Point, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc.
* Speak fluent English and excellent in reading, writing.
* Independently manage customers programs with minimum supervision.
* Well understanding of engine knowledge, performance, aftertreatment, NVH.
* More than 8 years of engine experience including application, design, performance, validation, etc.
* Bachelor degree or above in Engineering


**Desired Qualifications**
* Transmission and hydraulic knowledge.
* EP Knowledge, especially Data Center experience.
* External customer facing experience.


**Additional Information**
* Able to travel globally up to 50% of time to meet customer expectation and support sales.
* Willingness to visit customer site at short notice (less than 24 hrs) to investigate customer critical field issues.

**Job Description**
**What you’ll do:**
 The Advanced Services team provides exceptional outcomes and remarkable customer experience through "forward\-looking" technical services to optimize network reliability and performance for designated customers. We are passionate about enabling our customers towards a fast, risk\-free deployment of network services. We assist our customers to evaluate network for performance, scalability, and security and provides recommendations on network configurations and topologies to improve operational performance and identify/ mitigate major risk areas. Partnering on short\-term projects such as recommendation and implementation of new HPE Networking software and hardware features in the customer's network.

 Key responsibilities include the following, but are not limited to:
   

  

* The two main aspect of the role would be to represent HPE Networking customer service to the customer and as representative of the customer back to Juniper.

 Knowledge and experience of the newest technologies such as Segment Routing, Traffic engineering, DC switching, VxLAN, EVPN, SD\-WAN \& Wireless is a plus.
   

  

 Experience working in large enterprises, Network service providers have added advantage.
   

  

 ITIL Framework process knowledge will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Experience and desire to work on automation will be valuable in long run.
   

  

 Amiable communication, interpersonal and social skills will make a difference!
   

  

 HPE Networking product certifications (HPE Aruba Networking – switching, Campus access, Data Center, HPE Juniper – JNCIA/JNCIS/JNCIP/JNCIE) or industry equivalents are helpful.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
 We generally prefer candidates with bachelor’s degree in electrical/electronic Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent. A Business degree such as MBA would be an advantage.
   

  

 9\+ years’ experience in designing, implementing, and solving technical problems of the state\-of\-the\-art Datacenter, IP/MPLS\- Networks. High exposure to network operations environment. Ability to operate independently, including management of priorities in unstructured environment with good communication skills.

description:

 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 




 At Anaplan, we optimize enterprise decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform. Acting as a trusted subject matter expert and strategic leader within Anaplan’s Integrated Business Applications organization, the
 **Supply Chain, Strategy and Transformation Director**

 **Product Management, Enablement, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Partners** 
 .
 





 This role combines deep functional and process domain expertise (In Supply Chain and Manufacturing space) with technical application architecture, consultative selling, and ecosystem enablement. You will support Anaplan’s GTM Teams on all engagements that require your domain expertise, from initial demand generation programs to initial discovery and through to implementation, and expansion.
 





 Preferred Location \- Mumbai / Bangalore / Gurgaon.

 Partner seamlessly with Anaplan’s GTM Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain Enterprise Planning Applications into Anaplan’s GTM motion by:
 



* Contribute to the creation and delivery of scalable knowledge\-sharing initiatives including compelling sales programs, executive presentations, ROI insights and customer success stories, and enablement assets (training materials, technical guides, evaluation frameworks) to empower internal teams and partners.
* Distill deep domain expertise and positioning into crisp, actionable sales tactics. Ensuring Supply Chain Applications presentations and demonstrations are clearly aligned with prospect and customer requirements. Support all stages of complex sales opportunities both onsite and remotely as a technical, process, and architectural expert. Act as ambassador to and advocate for application customers post\-sale, driving expansion.
* Support our Platform, Application and AI Teams with application design and best practices, pre\-market testing and early adopter customers. Capture structured feedback and translate field insights from customer, prospect, and partner engagements to Product Management to shape application roadmap priorities
* Support Anaplan, Analyst and Industry engagements and events as a key thought leader, including producing thought leadership content across diverse media. Contribute to market insights, whitepapers, top\-of\-mind and high\-impact use cases for customer discovery and executive presentations.
* Collaborating with the Competitive Intelligence Team to deliver competitive differentiation in Anaplan’s positioning and value proposition, sharpening battlecards, and providing win reports that drive useable insights and tactics.



 Key Metrics
 
* Adoption and successful completion of enablement by GTM Teams.
* Number of presentations, demonstrations, and other supporting activities of your Domain Applications.
* Total revenue, deal volume, and pipeline value associated with or influenced by Domain Applications.
* Qualitative evaluations and ratings from our GTM Teams.



 Qualifications
 
* **More than a decade of experience in Supply Chain Planning space**
* Demonstrable understanding of Anaplan’s platform and its applications to solve complex business challenges (Or similar EPM / Enterprise Planning / Supply \& Demand Planning solutions in the market)
* **Deep domain knowledge of Supply \& demand planning** 
 , at strategic, operational and headcount levels, the market of Supply Chain focused \- Enterprise performance management, planning and reporting solutions, required processes and best practices, and the key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* **Understanding of product management, enablement and GTM operations.**
* Proven experience in consultative selling or strategic advisory roles, preferably within SaaS or enterprise software, with the ability to ask the right questions, manage objections, and guide the sales journey from start to implementation and expansion.
* **Have background working in Manufacturing industry – preferable to have worked directly in a manufacturing company in the past before transitioning to SaaS or Enterprise Software organizations.**
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge\-sharing skills, with a demonstrated exceptional ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.
* A results\-driven mindset, able to collaborate across teams, with a focus on contributing deliverables of the highest possible quality and impact.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. title: Presales & Business Development Manager
description:
**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are hiring a
 **Presales \& Business Development Manager** 
 to own the solution side of new\-logo pursuits in North America. You will pair with our hunters and sales leadership from first meeting through signature: qualifying the opportunity, shaping the solution and commercial construct with delivery, leading the proposal, and carrying the pitch in front of CIO and CTO\-level buyers.
 



 This is a hands\-on, outcome\-measured role. Your success is the pipeline you help create and qualify across our service lines, the proposals you lead, and the deals that close. You will work directly with the founders and CXOs and shape how Galent sells, not just respond to what comes in.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




***Pipeline and Pursuit Leadership***



* Partner with hunters and account owners to qualify new\-logo opportunities and build pipeline across all four service lines
* Lead pursuits end to end for multi\-year application development, modernization and managed services deals, including RFI/RFP/RFQ responses and proactive proposals
* Run the bid: pursuit plan, win themes, workstream owners, review cadence and timeline to submission



***Solutioning and Commercials***



* Translate client business problems into structured solutions across our service lines, working as a peer with delivery leads and solution architects on cloud, data platforms and AI\-assisted SDLC
* Build the estimate and commercial model: staffing pyramid, rate card, T\&M vs fixed price vs managed services constructs, transition and steady\-state economics
* Position the GalentAI platform and its services as concrete productivity, quality and cost outcomes for the client



***Client Engagement and GTM***



* Lead orals, solution walkthroughs and executive presentations with US enterprise buyers; anchor discovery and due\-diligence conversations with architecture, procurement and business stakeholders

* Keep every opportunity current in Salesforce; nothing enters the plan that is not in the CRM



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




***Must\-haves***



* 5–7 years in IT services presales or solution sales, with at least 2 years owning the solution response end to end on multi\-year ADM or managed services deals of $1M\+ TCV. Bid lead, not contributor
* Worked inside at least one $5M\+ pursuit with ownership of a solution or commercial workstream
* Hands\-on experience building estimates and pricing models for services engagements
* Techno\-functional depth: can hold an architecture conversation on cloud, data platforms and modern SDLC tooling, and knows where GenAI and agentic approaches transform the solution
* Direct experience with US enterprise clients



***Differentiators***



* Sold or solutioned AI\-native delivery: agentic development tooling, AI\-assisted SDLC or platform engineering
* Alliance or partner experience with AWS, Azure, GCP or a global system integrator



***How you work***



* Bias for outcomes: measures yourself on pipeline and closed revenue, not documents produced
* Comfortable operating without a finished playbook, and willing to write it; takes ownership to closure without waiting for direction



**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months** 



* Qualified new\-logo pipeline created with the hunting team meets the agreed annual target across service lines
* Every pursuit you lead ships on time with a defined win theme, estimate and commercial construct
* Proposal\-to\-win conversion on your pursuits at or above the company baseline
* At least one GalentAI platform\-led engagement sold into a new logo



  





**Why Join Galent?**

 **AI\-native digital engineering** 
 firm in a high\-growth phase
 



 ✅ Work
 **directly with founders and CXOs** 
 on live pursuits
 



 ✅ Shape offerings, pricing and GTM motion,
 **not just respond to RFPs**

title: Technical Quote Lead – Displays
description:
**Enabling a software\-defined, electrified future.**
 Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading\-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software\-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
   

  

**Mission of the Role:** 
 The Technical Quote Leader is responsible for leading new business pursuits/quotes for the Display product line and coordinating with all Display Product Line functions (Customer Regional Engineering, Mechanical, Display \& Lens teams, Hardware \& Platform Software teams, Program \& Commodity Purchasing and Manufacturing) and lead \& coordinate associated internal engineering activities. This role will have a clear understanding of why, what, and when of an assigned product and will communicate its story and the business value concisely to all stakeholders.
   

  

**Typical Duties:** 
 Technical lead of Display related engineering activities for Customer RFIs \& Quotations: Lead multi\-functional global engineering internal team to Establish \& direct engineering team supporting pursuits/quotes within the Displays Product Line.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders:** 
 Multiple internal cross\-functional stakeholders (example: sales, manufacturing, engineering); OEM customers; strategic suppliers.
   

  

**Key Objectives of the Role:**
* Technical Lead for RFx Quotations:
+ Lead global engineering team.
+ Direct engineering team for new product line pursuits/quotes.
+ Review new product requirements (Mechanical, HW, SW).
+ Coordinate technical deliverables for quote timeline.
+ Develop optimal designs and review BOM costs.
+ Ensure timely completion of quote documentation (TDR, BOM, assumptions).
+ Work with Product Management \& commercial team on cost targets.
+ Identify and initiate long lead items.
+ Align make/buy strategy with Manufacturing \& Purchasing.
+ Review supplier quotes with Purchasing.
+ Optimize assembly process with Manufacturing.

* Should Cost/Should Price:
+ Lead should\-cost and should\-price estimations (Display, Lens, eBOM, mBOM).
+ Review should\-cost and should\-price with stakeholders.
+ Collaborate with Purchasing and Customer Groups on cost/price targets.
+ Align strategies on winning cost targets and prices with related teams and management.

* Process Compliance:
+ Ensure compliance during the quote process.
+ Support customer milestones and requirements.


**Key Year One Deliverables:**
* Strategic Growth : Develop strategies to expand Display products and increase market share.
* Should Cost and Should Price Management: Increase winning rate by estimating the cost and price precisely.
* Roadmap Validation : Continuously validate and adjust the product roadmap based on customer feedback and industry trends.
* RFQ Acquisition : Secure RFQs from auto OEMs to ensure significant lifetime value for the Display business.
* Technology Leadership : Introduce cutting\-edge technologies to drive product and feature competitiveness.
* Cost Optimization : Create product value propositions and cost reduction proposals to optimize costs.


**Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:**
**Key experience required:**
* Years of Experience: 3\+ years of Automotive Display product experience or similar;
* Degree Strongly Preferred: Bachelor of Science (minimum), in Mechanical, Displays, or Electronic Engineering (EE), or a related field with equivalent experience.


**Desired Competencies/Experience:**
* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously;
* Flexibility to support regions/countries in different time zones;
* Proven ability to lead and manage multi\-functional global engineering internal team .
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with global cultural sensitivity.
* Strong presentation skills;
* Ability to understand, at a high level mechanical, display design, electronics \& associated implementation;
* Good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
* Good communication skills especially with Customers;
* Ability to work within a constrained deadline (quotes are tight and time\-bound);
* Ability to work closely with suppliers for part selections and negotiations;
* A Plus – deep understanding of displays \& touch technology;
* A Plus –understanding of commercial/business/financial measurement (NPV, IRR, EBIT, etc.);
* A Plus – experience with Jira, Confluence and AI agents
* Fluent in English;
* Self\-motivated with the ability to lead a global team toward a common goal.
* Special Requirements (i.e. overtime, travel, etc.): Domestic and international travel to internal and customer locations may be required (\~5\-10%).


**Key Behaviors:**
* Collaboration;
* Result – oriented;
* Critical thinking;
* Evaluating problems;


**Reporting Structure:** 
 Reports to the Associate Manager of the Display Quote team.
   

  

**In the fast** 
 lane of technology. At Visteon, we’re redefining how the world connects through its vehicles. Our innovations transform the driving experience for millions, powered by a high\-performance culture that challenges the status quo and sparks new possibilities—in careers and communities. Join us and help shape the future.

title: Territory Manager, South India
description:

 Headquartered in the vibrant city of Galway, Ireland, with offices around the world, Aerogen is proud to be the world leader in acute care aerosol drug delivery. Recognised through multiple MedTech awards, including being named Galway Chamber Company of the Year 2025, and twelve\-time winner of the Zenith Award for Respiratory Care Excellence in North America, our employees make a difference to patients’ lives every day, having reached over 30 million patients in more than 80 countries.
 



  





 Today, Aerogen is powered by a global team representing 54 nationalities, working together with a shared commitment to improving patient care. Our talented and skilled team collaborate to innovate, challenge and test not only in relation to our products but every facet of how we work.
 



  





 We lead the way by finding innovative solutions to even the most complex problems, all in the name of delivering better patient outcomes.
 



  





 Our business continues to grow rapidly across the globe and, as we grow, our core culture of “We Care” universally connects us. We believe that your ambition and integrity fuels ours, and we are committed to supporting our employees to reach their full potential through tangible investment in their careers.
 



  





**What is the role?** 




 The person in this role is responsible for enabling the commercial performance of our distribution partners by providing clinical support and training on Aerogen products to the products’ end users. The Territory Manager leverages their own deep knowledge of Aerogen products, services and processes to nurture the relationship with existing customers and follow up and develop new opportunities. The Territory Manager supports the distributor to deliver the pipeline of sales by communicating the value of Aerogen products to the customers to overcome the clinical and commercial barriers to achieve the changes required of the customer to adopt Aerogen, whilst forging strong working relationships with cross functional teams especially Sales, Marketing and Medical Affairs.
 



  





**What are the key responsibilities?** 




 • Develop and implement a territory plan driving Aerogen revenues through customer engagement (at all levels), territory management and effective collaboration with Aerogen OEM and distributor partners;
 



 • Delivery of high quality territory action plan following Aerogen commercial excellence framework including:
 



 • Key account performance based on account potential and ensure execution against these accounts
 



 • Reporting of weekly activities using the CRM tool
 



 • Leverage of omnichannel customer tools to drive / reinforce access
 



 • Leverage of global marketing campaigns
 



 • Sales support including training, support for distributor and OEM partners
 



 • Work with distributors partners within the region to align on strategic direction
 



 • Collaborate with distributors partners to align on focus for growth
 



 • Drive utilization of Aerogen’s sales excellence and learning management tools with distributors partners
 



 • Ensure strong customer engagement including systematic KOL engagement and close liaison with Medical Affairs in key accounts as required
 



 • Partner with Aerogen’s Marketing team on the launch of new products
 



 • Conduct, in partnership with the distributor, peer to peer and promotion events in their assigned territory.
 



 • Ensure strong engagement within the territory governmental sectors main KOLs responsible for major tender procurements such as Ministry of health.
 



 • Build an access to main reimbursement authority within his territory including main insurance company to enhance products being approved and covered under insurance umbrella.
 



 • May participate in partners QBR meetings
 



  





**What education and experience are required?** 




 • BA or BS degree or equivalent work experience.
 



 • Previous experience in similar commercial roles within the medical device industry
 



  





**What key skills will make you great at the role?** 




 • A challenger who understands well the customer’s business and uses that understanding to push the customer’s thinking and teach them something new about how they can compete more effectively
 



 • A results\-oriented individual who can assess the medium\- and long\-term impact of the solutions they propose
 



 • An innovator who is not afraid to try new approaches
 



 • A team player who constructively partners with others to achieve goals
 



 • Good understanding of financial drivers and ability to influence the financial customers
 



 • Strong clinical acumen
 



 • Strong learning application
 



 • A learning partner who understands the company and knows the product and can effectively share their knowledge and enthusiasm with a new colleague
 



 • A relationship builder who can effectively work cross functionally
 



 • High energy and self\-driven to achieve targets
 



 • Strong territory management skills and proven ability to drive multiple opportunities Excellent organizational and communication skills
 



 • Ability to manage a complex sales process that has clinical and financial customers
 



 • Proficiency in use of desktop software applications, such as MS office, LMS and CRM
 



 • Ability to travel extensively domestically (approximately 80% of time) and internationally as require
 



  





**What is it like to work at Aerogen?** 




 Our purpose is to transform patient lives, and our ethos is to
 **\#discoverbetter** 
 . This also translates to how we look after our people. We want talented, passionate and engaged people to join Aerogen and build your career with us. We understand that your life evolves through different stages, and we are here to support our global team with a range of financial and non\-financial rewards and benefits. There’s something for everyone! Here is an idea of what we offer:
 



 • Competitive bonus plan.
 



 • Above market life insurance.
 



 • Opportunities for development and professional growth.
 



 • "Aerogen Connect" – our employee\-led program that helps our global teams unite and have fun.
 



 • We donate 1% of profits and time to charities and organizations.
 



  





 Visit our careers website for more information about life at Aerogen.
 



 Aerogen is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. If you have difficulty using our application process, please contact us via email at careers@aerogen.com. Please provide your name and preferred contact method.

* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies

**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – Health Care**

* Hands\-on exposure of one or more of the following: Payer, Provider, Market access, Enrolment, Distribution, Network, Claims service, Population health management, Value based care in a consulting / advisory role
* Interest and knowledge about the current trends in Healthcare space, especially pertaining to the US market
* Understanding of the Medicare, Medicaid and Commercial payer businesses
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders is a plus
* Ability to generate leading market insights from market data
* Certifications in healthcare domain (AHM 250/500, HIPAA etc.) are a plus


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Ability to develop understanding of new topics quickly; conduct targeted research and derive insights relevant for client
* Clear and concise communication – ability to articulate thoughts well, ask relevant questions – be able to participate in team discussions (both internally and with clients)
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members, conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization


**Qualifications Required:**
* MBA or other Master’s degree from a premier (Tier\-1\) school in India or abroad
* 3 \- 7 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA), with focus on Healthcare sector


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

 and

 Deep domain knowledge in

**Why Join Silergy?**

 Attractive salary, performance bonuses, and career advancement opportunities.

title: Territory head
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mintifi is a technology\-led growth financing platform that powers India’s SME ecosystem by improving access to capital for businesses at every stage of growth. For nearly a decade, the company has supported SME enterprises, manufacturers, distributors, dealers, retailers, and exporters across India with tailored financing solutions. Its offerings include supply chain, dealer and vendor, equipment, solar, export, and working capital financing, as well as loan against property, helping businesses strengthen cash flow and expand capacity. description:
**Company:DeutscheTelekomDigitalLabs,Gurgaon**
 Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the behind\-the\-scenes powerhouse that fuels Deutsche Telekom’s passion \& commitment to cutting edge innovation \& out of the world customer experience.Wecreatecompellingdigitalpropositionsfortheworlds’largestTelekomgiantby building scalable and agile platforms to provide the best of digital experience to Deutsche Telekom customers across Europe.

* Enhanced customer experience, convergence, and increased business productivity, continuouslyinvestingintoentrepreneurialvaluecreationprojectstobuildagilityand cross functional teams in order to steer innovative business models.


 Weareagileandfocusedontheoverallmakeupoftheteam.Webelievethatwiththeright team \- anything is possible. If you’re looking for an environment that’s fun and friendly but incrediblyfast\-paced;aplacewherewemeasurethetimebetweenreleasesindays;aplace where our focus begins and ends at the consumer \- join us!
   

  

 Role:Engineering Manager — Forward Deployed
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 OneBot deflects contact\-center volume for Deutsche Telekom across nine European markets. The platform strategy has moved from building a single bot we own to running the harness that routes across best\-of\-breed dialog engines — Parloa, ElevenLabs, Wonderful, Decagon and OneBot — with a shared context layer beneath.
   

  

 That split creates two genuinely different engineering jobs. Three PODs build reusable capability: the Router, the Harness capabilities, and the Stability and Acceleration platform. This POD does not build capability. It owns the delivery of use cases inside the NatCos — getting engines live market by market, integrating APIs from systems we do not control, and clearing the business, security and procurement barriers that stand between a working capability and a customer being served by it.
   

  

 Historically that work was squeezed between platform priorities and NatCo deadlines, with no single owner. The result was repeated: multiple divergent integration patterns with vendors, per\-country workarounds, and platform features paused mid\-build. This role exists to own the outcome — and to own it without fragmenting the platform.
   

  

**Delivery Ownership**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of NatCo use cases: from requirement through integration, security clearance, launch and post\-launch quality.
* Hold the launch date. Sequence work across your squads, surface dependencies on the capability PODs early, and escalate rather than absorb.
* Own post\-launch outcomes, not just go\-live — deflection, containment and customer experience are yours after the switch is flipped.


**Partners and vendors**
* Run technology and dialog\-engine partners as delivery partners: onboarding under IT guidelines with defined entry and exit criteria, integration milestones, and SLAs that hold.
* Be the single technical point of contact partners escalate to, and the person who holds them to commitments.


**Stakeholders, security and compliance**
* Work with NatCo business owners, product, PSA, security, privacy and procurement to clear the non\-engineering blockers that stall AI launches.
* Drive security and privacy review to a decision — anticipate what reviewers will ask and bring it before they ask.


**People and team**
* Line\-manage the Forward Deployed Engineers and squad leads: hiring, growth, performance, and building the FDE career path.
* Build a team that is credible in front of a customer and in a code review — deploy engineers into markets without losing their engineering depth.


**Platform discipline**
* Push fixes and patterns discovered in the field back upstream into the owning capability POD, rather than solving them locally.
* Say no to the fast local workaround. Protecting one implementation across nine markets is part of the job, not a constraint on it.


**Must\-have Skills And Experience**
* Experience. 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers with hiring and performance ownership.
* Hands\-on integration depth. You have personally shipped production integrations against enterprise APIs — REST and event\-driven — in Java, Python or equivalent. You can read the code your team writes and review a design.
* Customer\-facing delivery. You have owned delivery in front of a customer, a partner or an internal business unit, where the commitment was yours and the systems were not.
* Vendor management. Onboarding and managing technology partners: commercial and technical entry criteria, integration milestones, SLA enforcement, and a defined exit.
* Security and compliance fluency. You have taken a product through enterprise security, privacy and procurement review — PSA, DPIA, pen\-test remediation or the equivalent — and know how to shorten it.
* Multi\-market rollout. Rolling the same platform into multiple markets, tenants or customers, and holding one implementation while doing it.
* AI systems literacy. Working knowledge of how modern LLM applications are built and operated: prompts and operating procedures, tool calling and MCP, RAG, evaluation, and voice pipelines including STT, TTS, endpointing and barge\-in. Enough to hold an architectural line in a partner conversation — you are not expected to invent the architecture.
* Ways of working. Comfortable operating across time zones with European stakeholders, with regular travel to markets.


**Nice To Have**
* Telecommunications or contact\-center domain experience — IVR, CCaaS, routing, agent desktop.
* A forward\-deployed or solutions\-engineering background, where engineers are embedded in the customer's environment to deliver an outcome.


**What This Role Is Not**
**Not a programme or project manager.** 
 The POD has a dedicated TPM who owns programme mechanics, cross\-POD dependencies and reporting. This role owns the engineering team and the outcome.
   

  

**Not an individual\-contributor architect.** 
 Engineers report to you. People leadership is a first\-class part of the job, not an overhead on it.

title: GeM & Tendering Expert
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven GeM \& Tender Executive to manage our organization's end\-to\-end presence and business on the Government e\-Marketplace (GeM) portal and other government tender platforms (CPPP, e\-Procurement portals, state portals, etc.). The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience across the complete GeM lifecycle — from vendor onboarding and assessment to bidding, reverse auction, forward auction, order fulfilment, and payment realization.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 

  





***GeM Portal Management***




 •     Manage day\-to\-day operations on the GeM portal including seller/vendor profile management, catalogue creation, and product/service listing.
 



 •     Ensure timely completion of vendor assessment processes, including document submission, compliance checks, and empanelment requirements.
 



 •     Monitor and maintain OEM/vendor authorization, brand approval, and product category approvals on GeM.
 



 •     Keep vendor assessment score, seller rating, and compliance metrics updated and healthy.
 



  





***Bidding \& Tendering***




 •     Search, shortlist, and evaluate relevant Bids/RFPs (Direct Purchase, L1 Bid, Custom Bid) and tenders on GeM and other e\-procurement platforms.
 



 •     Prepare and submit techno\-commercial bids, ensuring accuracy of pricing, technical specifications, and compliance with tender terms.
 



 •     Track bid submission deadlines, EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) payment, and document submission timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate with internal teams (finance, technical, logistics) for tender document preparation, pricing strategy, and eligibility criteria fulfilment.
 



  





***Reverse Auction (RA)***




 •     Participate actively in Reverse Auction (RA) events, monitoring live bidding and applying competitive pricing strategies within approved cost limits.
 



 •     Analyze competitor pricing patterns and market rates to strategize bid decrements.
 



 •     Ensure timely and accurate participation in RA to maximize win rate while maintaining profitability.
 



  





***Forward Auction***




 •     Manage and participate in Forward Auction processes on GeM, ensuring compliance with auction rules and timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate pricing approvals internally before auction participation.
 



 •     Track auction outcomes and maintain records for management review.
 



  





***Order \& Contract Management***




 •     Process Purchase Orders (PO)/Contracts received via GeM — verify terms, acknowledge orders, and coordinate execution timelines.
 



 •     Track order fulfilment status: dispatch, delivery, installation (if applicable), and consignee acceptance.
 



 •     Manage CRAC (Consignee Receipt\-cum\-Acceptance Certificate) generation and follow\-up.
 



 •     Handle order cancellations, replacements, and returns as per GeM guidelines.
 



  





***Payments \& Compliance***




 •     Track and follow up on payment realization through GeM's integrated payment system (PFMS/bill processing).
 



 •     Ensure GST invoicing, e\-way bills, and other statutory compliance for each transaction.
 



 •     Maintain documentation for performance bank guarantees (PBG), EMD refunds, and other financial instruments as required.
 



  





***Reporting \& Coordination***




 •     Maintain MIS/trackers for bids submitted, RA/FA participation, orders won, and payment status.
 



 •     Liaise with government buyers, procurement officers, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries or disputes.
 



 •     Stay updated on GeM policy changes, GFR (General Financial Rules), and CVC guidelines relevant to public procurement.
   




**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

 •     Strong working knowledge of the GeM portal — bidding, RA, FA, catalogue management, and vendor assessment modules.
 



 •     Familiarity with public procurement processes, GFR, and government tendering norms.
 



 •     Good understanding of pricing strategy and competitive bidding techniques.
 



 •     Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for tracking and reporting.
 



 •     Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
 



 •     Good communication and coordination skills for liaising with government departments and internal teams.

title: Travel Consultant
description:
**Company Description** 
 TOTAL HOLIDAY OPTIONS – INDIA specializes in designing customized tours to India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and the Maldives, focusing on both quality and value. The company creates travel experiences that highlight the rich cultural diversity and unique environments of each destination. Tours are tailored to provide high levels of comfort while maintaining competitive, attractive pricing. TOTAL HOLIDAY OPTIONS is an active member of multiple industry associations and is committed to innovation in its tour offerings and services. Team members join a forward\-looking organization that values creativity, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Inbound Travel Consultant role is based in the Greater Delhi Area. The role involves responding to inbound travel inquiries, understanding traveler preferences, and designing customized tour itineraries for guests visiting India and neighboring destinations. The consultant will prepare detailed proposals, costings, and travel documents, coordinate with hotels, transport providers, and local partners, and ensure smooth tour operations from initial inquiry to final departure. Daily responsibilities include managing reservations, updating customer records, handling changes or special requests, and providing timely and clear communication to clients and suppliers. The role also requires maintaining product knowledge of destinations, contributing ideas to improve tour offerings, and supporting colleagues to deliver high\-quality service.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong customer service and client relationship skills, with the ability to understand traveler needs and provide clear, professional communication.
* Experience in itinerary planning, tour operations, and reservation management within the travel or hospitality sector.
* Proficiency in written and spoken English; knowledge of additional languages is an advantage.
* Comfort using booking systems, office productivity tools, and online research to source and confirm travel services.
* Attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple inquiries and deadlines.
* Knowledge of Indian and regional destinations (India, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Maldives) and interest in culture and travel experiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively in an on\-site team environment in the Greater Delhi Area.
* Relevant education in tourism, hospitality, business, or a related field; prior experience as a travel consultant or in inbound tourism is preferred.

****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





 To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in
   

  





****About Industrial Markets****




 The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.
   

  





 At SKF, we provide industry\-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day\-to\-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

title: Presales Manager (Retail)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on
 **Presales Manager (Retail)** 
 to front\-end the organization's Presales function across service lines, business units and customer segments. The role requires a strong IT Services background, end\-to\-end presales ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with Sales, Delivery, Technology and Leadership teams to convert business opportunities into compelling, solution\-led proposals. The ideal candidate should bring strong Retail domain understanding and should be comfortable engaging with global enterprise customers, leading discovery discussions, shaping solution narratives, preparing proposals, coordinating estimates and presenting to senior stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* End\-to\-End Presales Ownership: Own the complete presales lifecycle from opportunity qualification to proposal submission and deal closure support.
* Partner with Sales teams to understand customer requirements, business objectives, pain points, and transformation priorities.
* Lead discovery sessions, customer workshops, solution walkthroughs, and executive presentations.
* Prepare compelling proposals, solution documents, RFI/RFP/RFQ responses, capability decks and executive presentations.
* Develop win themes, differentiators, solution positioning and value propositions aligned to customer priorities.
* Drive internal pursuit reviews and ensure alignment across Sales, Delivery, Technology and Leadership stakeholders.
* Solution Development and Consulting: Translate customer business problems into technology\-led solutions and engagement models.
* Work with technical SMEs, architects and delivery teams to define solution approach, delivery methodology and implementation roadmap.
* Create solution narratives that clearly articulate business value, delivery approach, risks, assumptions and expected outcomes.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, commercially viable, deliverable, and aligned with organizational capabilities.
* Support proactive proposal development and strategic account planning initiatives.
* Estimation, Pricing and Commercial Support: Coordinate effort estimation activities with Delivery, Engineering, QA, Data, Cloud, UX and other relevant teams.
* Support preparation of commercial models for Fixed Price, Time and Material, Managed Services, Dedicated Team and Outcome\-based engagements.
* Capture assumptions, dependencies, risk factors, staffing models and delivery milestones for proposal submissions.
* Support commercial discussions by providing inputs on scope, effort, delivery approach and solution value.
* Retail Domain Contribution: Apply Retail domain knowledge to create business\-relevant solutions for enterprise customers.
* Support opportunities across omnichannel retail, digital commerce, store operations, merchandising, customer experience, loyalty, inventory, fulfilment, supply chain, data analytics and AI\-led transformation.
* Understand how retail business processes connect with technology platforms, operating models and transformation programs.
* Contribute domain insights during customer conversations, solutioning workshops and proposal development.
* Presales Enablement Across the Organization: Act as the front\-end owner for presales activities across the organization, supporting multiple teams and opportunity types.
* Develop reusable presales assets, templates, case studies, capability presentations, solution frameworks and proposal libraries.
* Improve presales processes, governance, pursuit quality, proposal consistency and response timelines.
* Enable Sales and Delivery teams with sharper messaging, stronger positioning and customer\-ready collateral.


**Required Experience**
* Around 10 years of hands\-on presales experience in an IT Services environment.
* BE/BTech \+ MBA from a premium institute.
* Strong end\-to\-end presales exposure including opportunity qualification, requirement understanding, solutioning, proposal development, estimation coordination, pricing support and customer presentation.
* Must have worked in core IT Services organizations with exposure to enterprise customers and multi\-stakeholder pursuits.
* Strong Retail domain experience is mandatory.
* Experience supporting global customers across regions such as North America, Europe, Middle East or APAC is preferred.
* Experience working on medium to large\-sized deals, strategic pursuits and transformation\-led proposals is preferred.
* Core Skills and Expected Capability: Presales RFI/RFP/RFQ management, bid management, proposal writing, solution documentation, win themes, and value proposition development.
* Solutioning ability to translate business needs into practical technology solutions, delivery approaches, roadmaps, and commercial models.
* Retail domain expertise with strong understanding of retail operations, digital commerce, omnichannel, store systems, merchandising, loyalty, inventory, supply chain and customer experience.
* Commercial Acumen: Exposure to estimation, pricing, assumptions, dependencies, effort models and deal structuring.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling, executive presentations, and customer\-facing confidence.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to work with Sales, Delivery, Technology, Leadership and customer stakeholders in a matrix environment.

title: Sales Engineer (Presales)
description:
**About Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Your Role in a Nutshell**
 No two days are the same. You'll work hands\-on with market\-leading technologies, diagnose customers' toughest security challenges, and design solutions alongside partners — playing a central role in high\-impact projects from discovery through delivery. If you thrive at the intersection of deep technical expertise and real business impact, this is your seat at the table.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Drive the win. Partner with partner sales teams to identify prospects, progress opportunities, and demonstrate Check Point's value proposition where it matters most — in front of the customer.
* Be the face of Check Point. Present at partner\-led customer events, workshops, and industry forums, bringing our story and our technology to life.
* Prove it out. Lead and co\-execute POCs and technical assessments alongside partner technical and presales teams, turning prospects into believers.
* Lead with value. Guide conversations that uncover real business problems and translate them into winning technical solutions — not just feature lists.
* Be the trusted advisor. Serve as a go\-to cybersecurity resource for partner technical communities, fielding tough technical questions and articulating solution benefits with confidence.
* Stay sharp. Keep a pulse on cybersecurity trends and the competitive landscape so every engagement is informed by what's happening now.
* Support the full cycle. Help partners respond to RFIs/RFPs, share best practices, and manage POCs so every customer gets an excellent experience from first conversation to close.
* Enable others. Train and enable partners and customers on the latest security technologies, multiplying your impact across every account you touch.
* Grow the account. Position Check Point's portfolio to maximize cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within partner accounts.
* Deliver excellence. Build solution designs and high\-impact proposals that reinforce Check Point's reputation as a security leader.
* Represent the brand. Show up at cybersecurity events and live demos as a credible, engaging voice for Check Point.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring**
* 8\+ years in technology organizations, including 4–6\+ years in systems engineering, presales, or partner engineering roles
* A genuinely customer\-centric mindset and a commitment to delivering an excellent customer experience
* A hands\-on attitude — you're willing to roll up your sleeves and work through technical blockers yourself
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving instincts
* Solid understanding of networking technologies, application architectures, and solution design
* Experience building end\-to\-end security solutions spanning network, endpoint, and cloud
* Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can flex between technical depth and executive clarity
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., CCNP, CISSP, CCSA, CCSE)
* An engineering degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline


**Why This Role**
 This is a role for someone who wants more than a technical title — you'll shape how partners and customers experience Check Point, own high\-visibility engagements end to end, and be recognized as the technical expert people turn to when the stakes are high. If you're energized by variety, ownership, and solving real security problems alongside great partners, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
   

  

 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high\-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co\-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
   

  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025\. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.


**An Overview Of This Role**
 As a Senior Solutions Architect on GitLab's India team, you'll be a trusted advisor to prospects, customers, and partners across India. You'll help them understand how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform addresses technical requirements and business goals across the software development lifecycle. This role supports Commercial and Enterprise segments in India's Southern Region. Experience with Global Capability Centers (GCCs), Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued given the accounts you'll support.
   

  

 You'll partner closely with Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and bring customer feedback to Product Management. You'll also occasionally support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services. Your work will help customers adopt GitLab successfully, support revenue growth through solution selling, and build long\-term, trusted relationships.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead technical discovery, demonstrations, and validation to show how GitLab's AI\-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the software development lifecycle.
* Own the technical evaluation process, including solution design, proofs of concept or value, workshops, and technical contributions to tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.
* Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Commercial and Enterprise segments to shape account strategies for new customer acquisition and expansion, with a focus on GCC, Digital Native, and startup accounts.
* Support regional go\-to\-market partners that provide Professional Services, helping them deliver consistent technical guidance and apply effective practices during partner\-led engagements.
* Represent GitLab at online and in\-person marketing events, including webinars, industry events, presentations, roundtables, panels, demonstration days, and hackathons.
* Build trusted relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guide GitLab\-driven transformation, and help customers become GitLab advocates.
* Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), security, and cloud practices to improve their return on investment.
* Share customer feedback, use cases, and competitive insights with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing while continuing to build expertise and reusable guidance in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and cloud technologies.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience guiding Commercial and Enterprise customers through solution design and evaluation in technical presales, consulting, or a similar role.
* Experience working with India's GCCs, Digital Native organizations, and startups is highly valued.
* Knowledge of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, CI/CD, and collaboration platforms, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer use cases.
* Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, including deployment, security, and operations options.
* Ability to lead proofs of concept or value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.
* Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt your message for practitioners and senior business and technical decision\-makers.
* Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, advocating for customers, collaborating with go\-to\-market or Professional Services partners, and continuously learning new technologies.


**About The Team**
 The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives. This role focuses on Commercial and Enterprise opportunities across India's Southern Region and works with Account Executives, the broader go\-to\-market team, and regional partners that provide Professional Services. The team advises on architecture, runs technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guides customers through digital transformation. We collaborate asynchronously with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share effective practices, create reusable technical resources, and represent the voice of the customer. Our focus is helping customers modernize software delivery, adopt GitLab at scale, and navigate a changing AI and DevSecOps landscape.
   

  

**How GitLab Supports Full\-Time Employees**
* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well\-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation \& Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave


 Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
   

  

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** 
 GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location\-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
   

  

**Privacy Policy:** 
 Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
   

  

 GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

description:

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The GDS Forecasting COE Leader is a senior leadership role accountable for building, scaling, and running a Center of Excellence dedicated to commercial forecasting services for Life Sciences clients. The role sits at the intersection of consulting go\-to\-market growth, delivery, analytics capability\-building, and commercial performance. It owns the COE talent and methodology backbone and positions forecasting as a differentiated offering within the broader Life Sciences practice. Reporting to the Life Sciences GDS Leader, the role is the primary escalation point for client delivery quality and internal capability development.
   

  

**Essential Functions Of The Job**
**Go\-to\-Market**
* Partner with solution, account, and sector leaders to identify, shape, and pursue forecasting\-led opportunities across existing and prospective client accounts.
* Lead or co\-lead proposal development, including solution design, pricing strategy, and staffing plans for forecasting engagements and RFPs.
* Build reusable forecasting assets including accelerators, frameworks, demo models, and points of view to reduce proposal cycle time and improve win rates.
* Represent the COE in client pitches, oral presentations, and executive discussions.
* Track and report the COE sales pipeline, win/loss trends, revenue contribution, and forecast to Life Sciences leadership.
* Develop and publish thought leadership, benchmarking studies, and conference content to establish market credibility.
* Identify and evaluate strategic alliances with forecasting technology and data partners to strengthen the solution stack.


**Delivery**
* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of forecasting deliverables across COE\-supported engagements.
* Lead engagements spanning customized platform or solution development and forecasting managed services.
* Establish and enforce model validation, assumption documentation, MAPE/accuracy tracking, peer review, and audit\-readiness standards.
* Define and continuously refine forecasting methodologies, matching the approach to the business question and available data.
* Provide technical oversight over gross\-to\-net modeling, loss\-ofexclusivity impact, TRx/NBRx trends, market sizing, competitive dynamics, and related parameters.
* Manage engagement economics, including utilization, effort estimates, and margin performance.
* Build and mentor a multi\-tiered team from analysts through senior managers, balancing pharmaceutical commercial expertise and analytics capability.
* Institutionalize lessons learned, client feedback, and forecast\-accuracy post\-mortems into refreshed playbooks and training.
* Guide adoption of forecasting platforms and tools, including AI\-first and agentic forecasting architectures where relevant.
* Act as the escalation point for at\-risk engagements and resolve delivery, staffing, or client relationship issues.


**Analytical/Decision Making** 
**Responsibilities**
* Determine the appropriate forecasting methodology, model architecture, data sources, validation approach, and governance level for complex client needs.
* Prioritize investments across talent, assets, platforms, alliances, and adjacent capabilities based on pipeline, scalability, and expected value.
* Balance growth, quality, utilization, margin, and talent sustainability across the COE portfolio.
* Make senior interventions on at\-risk engagements and decide when models, assumptions, staffing, or delivery plans require correction.
* Translate quantitative model outputs and uncertainty into clear commercial decisions and executive narratives.


**Education \& Experience**
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Statistics, Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field from a reputed institution; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.
* 14\+ years of overall experience, including at least 8\-10 years in pharmaceutical or Life Sciences commercial forecasting.
* Experience in a top\-tier consulting firm, pharmaceutical commercial analytics function, or specialized forecasting firm is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a COE, practice area, or specialized delivery team, including P\&L or revenue accountability.
* Proven client\-facing delivery leadership across complex, multi\-market forecasting engagements.
* Experience managing large, distributed teams across onshore\-offshore delivery models.


**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**
* Deep expertise in pharmaceutical commercial forecasting, including MAPE, gross\-to\-net, loss of exclusivity, TRx/NBRx, market share dynamics, and epidemiology\- and analogue\-based methods.
* Strong familiarity with pharmaceutical data platforms and datasets, including IQVIA, Komodo Health, Symphony Health, claims, and EHR data.
* Proficiency in Excel modeling, R, Python, and forecasting\-specific platforms; familiarity with AI/ML forecasting and agentic AI applications is highly desirable.
* Strong business development capability across proposal writing, client pitching, pricing, and senior relationship management.
* Proven people leadership across team building, performance management, mentoring, and capability development.
* Executive presence and the ability to translate complex quantitative outputs into clear business narratives.

title: Senior – School Partnerships
description:
Senior – School Partnerships
 



  





 Company: Dreamtime Learning
 



 Location: Hyderabad, India \| Travel across India as required

 Working Days: Monday–Saturday
