 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior – School Partnerships professional who understands the Indian school ecosystem and can build trusted relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, academic heads and education leaders.
 



  





 This is a consultative business development and sales role. The successful candidate will combine education expertise, relationship\-building, storytelling and commercial ability to engage schools, understand their needs and create opportunities for meaningful AI\-led transformation.
 



  





 We are looking for people who can tell a compelling story, influence senior stakeholders and convert conversations into partnerships.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Build School Partnerships
 



  





 \* Build and maintain strong relationships with school owners, trustees, principals and academic leaders.
 



 \* Develop a high\-quality network of schools across India.
 



 \* Identify and qualify new institutional opportunities.
 



 \* Build relationships from initial introduction through engagement, negotiation and closure.
 



 \* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and education institutions.
 



  





 Consultative Sales \& Business Development
 



  





 \* Understand the academic, operational and strategic challenges faced by schools.
 



 \* Identify opportunities where Dreamtime Learning can create meaningful value.
 



 \* Lead discovery conversations, presentations, workshops and demonstrations.
 



 \* Convert school challenges into compelling business and education propositions.
 



 \* Manage the sales cycle from prospecting → discovery → presentation → proposal → negotiation → closure.
 



 \* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
 



 \* Achieve agreed monthly and quarterly business development and revenue targets.
 



  





 Storytelling \& Stakeholder Engagement
 



  





 \* Present ideas around the future of education, AI and school transformation in a simple, compelling and relatable way.
 



 \* Be an engaging storyteller who can make senior education stakeholders understand why change is necessary and what is possible.
 



 \* Adapt communication to different audiences, from teachers and academic heads to principals, trustees and school owners.
 



 \* Conduct engaging workshops and leadership conversations.
 



 \* Represent Dreamtime Learning at principal forums, Sahodaya circles, education conclaves, conferences and industry events.
 



  





 Market Development
 



  





 \* Generate new opportunities through networking, referrals, events and existing relationships.
 



 \* Expand the school’s institutional network across assigned territories.
 



 \* Develop relationships with education communities, associations and influential stakeholders.
 



 \* Track market trends, competitor activity and changing school priorities.
 



 \* Identify new markets and partnership opportunities.
 



  





 Voice of the School
 



  





 \* Understand the real needs and challenges of schools.
 



 \* Capture market feedback and share insights with Academic, Product, Marketing and Leadership teams.
 



 \* Help shape how Dreamtime Learning communicates its value to schools.
 



 \* Identify emerging needs that can influence future offerings and engagement strategies.
 



  





 Key Result Indicators (KRIs)
 



  





 Performance will be measured across commercial growth, relationship development and school engagement.
 



  





 Commercial KRIs
 



  





 \* Achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue / business targets.
 



 \* Number and value of qualified opportunities generated.
 



 \* Sales pipeline development and pipeline coverage.
 



 \* Number of school meetings and qualified stakeholder conversations.
 



 \* Presentation and demonstration\-to\-opportunity conversion.
 



 \* Proposal\-to\-closure conversion rate.
 



 \* Number of new institutional partnerships closed.
 



 \* Revenue generated from new and existing partnerships.
 



  





 Relationship KRIs
 



  





 \* Growth and quality of the school network.
 



 \* Number of senior\-level relationships established.
 



 \* Engagement with school owners, trustees, principals and academic heads.
 



 \* Referrals and opportunities generated through existing relationships.
 



 \* Participation and engagement in key education forums and networks.
 



  





 Engagement \& Adoption KRIs
 



  





 \* Workshops and school leadership sessions conducted.
 



 \* Quality of stakeholder engagement.
 



 \* Successful transition of partnerships from sales to implementation.
 



 \* Expansion opportunities within existing school relationships.
 



 \* Partner satisfaction and relationship health.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who combines education credibility, storytelling ability and commercial drive.
 



  





 Essential
 



  





 \* 5\+ years of experience in the K\-12 ecosystem — EdTech, publishing, curriculum, school leadership, education services, technology or related sectors.
 



 \* Strong understanding of the Indian school ecosystem.
 



 \* Existing relationships with school owners, principals, trustees or academic leaders will be highly valued.
 



 \* Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
 



 \* Strong consultative selling and business development capability.
 



 \* Confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
 



 \* Ability to understand needs, influence decisions and close opportunities.
 



 \* Good understanding of pedagogy, curriculum, school operations and technology adoption.
 



 \* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
 



 \* Strong digital awareness and willingness to learn about AI and emerging technologies.
 



 \* Laptop mandatory.
 



  





 The Person We Are Looking For
 



  





 You could be an education professional, curriculum leader, EdTech professional, school solutions specialist, consultant, institutional sales professional or school leader.
 



  





 More importantly, you are:
 



  





 A Storyteller
 



 You can take an idea and make people see its possibility.
 



  





 A Relationship Builder
 



 People trust you and are willing to open doors for you.
 



  





 A Consultative Seller
 



 You listen first, understand the problem and then create the right proposition.
 



  





 A Commercial Thinker
 



 You understand that relationships must ultimately translate into opportunities, partnerships and revenue.
 



  





 An Education Insider
 



 You understand how schools operate, how decisions are made and what matters to education leaders.
 



  





 An AI \& Innovation Enthusiast
 



 You are curious about how AI and emerging technologies can reshape education and can communicate these possibilities to non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 The successful person will become a trusted education advisor and a strong commercial representative of Dreamtime Learning — someone who can open doors, create meaningful conversations, build conviction, and ultimately turn those relationships into successful school partnerships.
 



  





 If you can build the relationship, tell the story, create the opportunity and close the partnership — we want to hear from you.

description:
**Our Company**
 At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 The Customer Renewal Manager (CRM) is responsible for driving the end\-to\-end renewal lifecycle for assigned customers in a defined Unit/Area. As part of Teradata’s Go\-To\-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline. The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.
   

  

 The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on\-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy. The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid\-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities. The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. The CRM will align the renewal strategy with the Account Executive (AE), Customer Solution Architect (CSA) and wider account team to achieve optimal results.

**Function / Department**
 Estimation

 Head of Estimation

**Travel**
 Frequent regional travel — OEM meetings and pre\-bid visits
   

  

**1\- Purpose Of The Role (Job Summary)**
 Lead mechanical, electrical, and ELV estimation for data center EPC bids. MEP is 60–70% of contract value, so this role drives both bid competitiveness and margin, including OEM pricing strategy for long\-lead plant.
   

  

**2\- Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
* Own the complete MEP estimate per tender: equipment, installation, subcontracts, commissioning support, and spares.
* Direct the discipline estimators to one estimate basis, boundary matrix, and assumptions log.
* Drive OEM budget pricing for long\-lead equipment — generators, UPS, switchgear, transformers, chillers, CRAH/CRAC/fan\-walls, busway — including delivery and escalation terms.
* Read tender documents for DC\-specific drivers: redundancy topology (N\+1/2N), tier requirements, liquid cooling, EPMS/BMS scope, and phased fit\-out.
* Adjudicate MEP subcontractor quotes and normalize supply, installation, and commissioning splits.
* Maintain MEP benchmarks: cost/MW by topology and geography, cost per kW by system, and installation norms.
* Prepare MEP risk registers, exclusions, and contingency recommendations.
* Lead MEP value engineering with design; quantify alternates for topology, plant selection, and phasing.
* Hand as\-sold estimates to delivery, then reconcile against actuals and update norms.


**3\- Key Performance Indicators**
* As\-sold vs final MEP cost variance within ±5%.
* At least 2 compliant OEM quotes per critical equipment class.
* 100% on\-time MEP estimate delivery per bid plan.
* Benchmark database refreshed quarterly.
* Value\-engineering savings identified and accepted per bid.


**4\- Qualifications \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (mandatory).
* CDCP preferred; CDCS, PMP, or Uptime ATD an advantage.


**5\- Experience**
* 07\-10 years in MEP estimation for EPC and construction, including 6\+ years on data center facilities.
* Priced complete MEP scopes, with direct OEM negotiation on critical power and cooling plant.
* International or GCC pricing exposure is an advantage.


**6\- Competencies**
* Deep cost fluency across DC power and cooling chains.
* Strong OEM and subcontractor network.
* Structured estimate governance — one basis, no orphan assumptions.
* Commercially sharp on exclusions, escalation, and risk pricing.
* Leads distributed estimator teams to deadline.
* Leadership, Analytical Thinking


**Work Experience**
**7\- Technical Skills**
 MEP cost estimation, BOQ preparation, HVAC and electrical systems, vendor quote adjudication, cost planning, and Excel.
   

  

**8\- Key Interfaces**
* Internal: Proposal/Tender Manager, CSA Estimation Manager, discipline estimators, Design \& Engineering (MEP), SCM, Finance \& Commercial.
* External: OEMs (gensets, UPS, chillers, switchgear, busway), MEP subcontractors, client and PMC counterparts.


**9\- Special Conditions**
 Heavy coordination across multiple MEP disciplines under bid deadlines.

You will own solution architecture across the full lifecycle—from discovery and solution design through implementation, go\-live, optimization, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong healthcare domain expertise with enterprise architecture, implementation leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex operational requirements into practical, scalable technology solutions.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Enterprise Solution Architecture**
* Own solution architecture for a portfolio of strategic enterprise healthcare accounts from initial discovery through implementation and steady state
* Understand complex client workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, regulatory requirements, and technology environments
* Design scalable, secure, and configurable solutions that address multi\-site, multi\-state, and multi\-payer requirements
* Translate business and operational requirements into detailed solution architectures, workflows, integrations, configurations, and implementation plans
* Serve as the senior architectural counterpart to client technology, operations, finance, and business leadership
* Ensure solutions align with product capabilities, technical standards, security requirements, and long\-term scalability


**Solution Design \& Implementation**
* Lead architecture and solution design for complex enterprise implementations involving multiple locations, states, payers, workflows, and system integrations
* Define system configuration, integration dependencies, data flows, workflows, and implementation sequencing
* Work with implementation and engineering teams to ensure architectural decisions are translated accurately into production\-ready solutions
* Identify implementation risks, dependencies, technical constraints, and opportunities for standardization early in the lifecycle
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, configuration templates, solution frameworks, and implementation playbooks
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying recurring implementation challenges and addressing them at the platform or architecture level


**Healthcare Revenue Cycle \& Domain Architecture**
* Apply strong knowledge of US healthcare revenue cycle processes to solution design, particularly outpatient and professional billing environments
* Translate requirements related to payer rules, claims processing, denials, eligibility, payment posting, reimbursement, and revenue cycle workflows into scalable technology solutions
* Understand healthcare transactions and standards including 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, EDI, ERA, and payer enrollment
* Incorporate requirements related to CMS\-1500, UB\-04, claim edits, NCCI logic, modifiers, therapy\-specific billing rules, claim scrubbing, remit reconciliation, and payment workflows
* Evaluate regulatory and payer changes and assess their implications for product architecture, integrations, and solution design
* Identify recurring operational or billing issues and work with product and engineering teams to address root causes through platform capabilities rather than manual intervention


**Enterprise Pre\-Sales \& Solution Consulting**
* Act as the senior solution architecture expert during enterprise sales pursuits, RFPs, discovery sessions, technical evaluations, and client presentations
* Lead solution discovery with prospective clients to understand business, operational, technical, and integration requirements
* Define what can realistically be delivered within existing product and technical capabilities and identify areas requiring customization or product enhancement
* Develop solution proposals, architecture approaches, implementation assumptions, integration strategies, and technical responses for enterprise opportunities
* Partner with sales and commercial teams to ensure technical commitments are accurate, achievable, and clearly documented
* Ensure requirements are captured effectively and handed over to implementation teams without unnecessary re\-discovery or ambiguity


**Product \& Technology Strategy**
* Translate enterprise customer requirements into actionable product and engineering requirements
* Partner with product leadership to influence roadmap priorities based on recurring customer needs, market requirements, and healthcare industry changes
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, configurability, automation, interoperability, and operational efficiency
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation and AI across healthcare workflows and revenue cycle processes
* Establish reusable architectural standards and patterns that enable faster implementation of future enterprise accounts
* Contribute to technical documentation, solution standards, architecture guidelines, and organizational knowledge repositories


**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Work effectively across product, engineering, implementation, operations, sales, finance, compliance, and customer\-facing teams
* Lead through influence across cross\-functional teams without relying solely on direct reporting structures
* Provide architectural guidance and mentorship to solution architects, implementation teams, and other technical stakeholders
* Establish clear ownership, decision\-making frameworks, escalation paths, and delivery standards for complex solutions
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


**Architecture Governance \& Performance**
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, design principles, integration patterns, and solution governance processes
* Review proposed solutions for scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, and maintainability
* Monitor implementation and solution performance and identify opportunities for optimization
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring issues, evaluate solution effectiveness, and drive improvements
* Ensure enterprise solutions meet agreed business outcomes, technical standards, and implementation timelines


 What We're Looking For
   

  

**Must\-Have**
* 12\-16 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, healthcare technology, revenue cycle technology, or related domains
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise healthcare solutions for large, multi\-site or multi\-state provider organizations
* Deep understanding of US healthcare revenue cycle processes, including professional billing, commercial insurance, Medicare/Medicaid, claims, denials, appeals, and payment workflows
* Strong working knowledge of healthcare interoperability and transaction standards, including EDI, 837, 835, 270/271, 277CA, and ERA
* Experience leading complex implementations involving multiple systems, integrations, locations, states, and payer requirements
* Strong understanding of healthcare technology environments, including EMR/EHR, practice management, RCM, and healthcare SaaS platforms
* Excellent spoken and written English with the ability to independently lead executive\-level business and technical discussions with US\-based clients
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional leadership skills
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical architectures and actionable implementation plans
* Data\-driven and structured approach to problem\-solving, architecture decisions, and solution optimization
* Comfortable working with teams and clients across US Eastern Time Zone working hours


**Strong Preference**
* Experience with outpatient rehabilitation workflows, including PT, OT, or SLP billing
* Knowledge of therapy\-specific requirements such as the 8\-minute rule, therapy thresholds, KX modifiers, plan\-of\-care certification, and therapy modifiers
* Experience with multi\-state Medicaid or workers' compensation environments
* Experience working with healthcare SaaS, EMR/EHR, practice management, or RCM technology companies
* Experience in startup or high\-growth environments where architecture standards, implementation frameworks, and playbooks were built from the ground up


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with facility billing and UB\-04 workflows
* Exposure to FQHC, CORF, ORF, mobile, or home\-based healthcare environments
* Pre\-sales, solutions consulting, technical sales, or product management experience
* Healthcare certifications such as CPC, COC, CRCR, CPB, CPMA, RHIA, or RHIT
* Experience implementing automation, AI, or intelligent workflow solutions within healthcare or revenue cycle environments
* Familiarity with HL7 and broader healthcare interoperability standards
* Understanding of HIPAA, healthcare data security, and compliance requirements


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* US Healthcare
* HIPAA
* HL7 Standards
* Enterprise Solution Architecture
* Healthcare Technology \& Integrations
* Solution Design \& Implementation
* Revenue Cycle Management


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong Communication
* Pre\-Sales / Solutions Consulting
* Healthcare Interoperability
* AI \& Automation
* Product Strategy

title: Senior Platform Architect-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Platform Architect\-1
   

  

**Overview**
 Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in\-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
   

  

 Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
   

  

 This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
   

  

 This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
   

  

 Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
   

  

 Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
   

  

 Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
   

  

 Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.


**All About You**
* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high\-energy, proactive, detail\-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self\-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro\-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments


**Skills/Abilities**
* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on\-the\-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross\-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Enterprise Solutions & Deal Enablement Associate
description:
**Role Overview**
 TartanHQ builds
 **HyperSync** 
 (a unified API layer connecting HRMS, ERP, and CRM systems) and
 **HyperVerify** 
 (a unified verification platform for KYC, KYB, income, employment, and contact\-point checks, used by banks, NBFCs, insurers, and lenders).
   

  

 We're hiring three
 **Enterprise Solutions \& Deal Enablement Associates** 
 to sit directly with the solutioning lead, founders and CBO, and become the connective tissue between our enterprise clients and every internal team that has to say "yes" before a deal goes live \- Product, Engineering, InfoSec, Legal, and Finance.
   

  

 This is not a pure sales role and not a pure support role. You will:
   

  

* Help scope and move new business opportunities forward with enterprise prospects across travel, employee benefits, BFSI/NBFC and lending, and pension/insurance players.
* Own the internal chase: security questionnaires, MSAs/DPAs, commercial paperwork, technical scoping so deals don't stall waiting on an internal team
* Stay the client's single point of contact through the entire journey, from first solutioning conversation through contracting to go\-live, so they never feel dropped between teams
* Bring an end\-to\-end ownership mindset: if something is blocking a deal or a client, it's your job to notice, chase, and resolve it, not to wait for someone to ask


 You'll be working alongside the solutioning lead, founders and CBO on a near\-daily basis, so this role has an unusually high amount of visibility and room to grow into a broader BD/solutions leadership track as we scale.
   

  

**Key Success Metrics (KPIs)**
- Deal Cycle Turnaround: Reduce time from first solutioning call to signed contract through proactive internal coordination

- InfoSec/Vendor Questionnaire Turnaround: Coordinated response within 3\-7 business days of receipt

 Contract\-to\-Go\-Live Time: \< 30 days for standard integrations, tracked jointly with Product/EngineeringClient Response Time: \< 4 hours during business hours for any active deal or account query
 - Internal SLA Adherence: 90%\+ of InfoSec/Legal/Finance/Product touchpoints closed within agreed internal timelines

- Active Relationships Managed: Ability to concurrently manage 8–12 live deals/accounts without dropped threads

- Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from both external clients and internal teams (Product, InfoSec, Legal, Finance) on responsiveness and clarity

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deal Support \& Solutioning (35%)
* Support the leaders through discovery calls, solution walkthroughs, and RFP/RFI responses for enterprise prospects
* Translate client requirements (HRMS/ERP/CRM integration needs, or KYC/KYB/income/employment verification needs) into a clear internal brief for Product/Engineering
* Prepare first\-cut proposals, solution decks, sample payloads, and commercial summaries to keep deal momentum going
* Track every open opportunity in a shared pipeline/tracker and flag stalled deals before they go cold
* Cross\-Functional Coordination – InfoSec, Legal, Finance, Product (30%)
* Own the InfoSec review process for prospects (security questionnaires, ISO 27001/ISO 27701/AICPA/DPDP compliance documentation, VAPT reports) in coordination with the infosec teams, chase, don't wait
* Coordinate MSA, DPA, SOW, and NDA drafting and redlines between the client and TartanHQ's legal counsel, keeping a clear track
* Work with Finance on commercial proposals, pricing confirmations, PO tracking, and invoicing setup for new accounts
* Liaise with Product/Engineering to confirm technical feasibility, connector availability, and realistic go\-live timelines before commitments are made to clients
* Client Relationship \& Communication (25%)
* Act as the client's primary point of contact through the deal cycle and into early production, so the relationship survives handoffs between internal teams
* Run a regular communication cadence (calls, status emails, WhatsApp where appropriate) with enterprise stakeholders including BFSI, NBFC, travel, insurance and pension\-sector clients
* Represent client context accurately back to the leaders and internal teams, no information getting lost in translation
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, additional endpoints) during ongoing conversations and flag them to the leaders
* Documentation, Reporting \& Process (10%)
* Maintain a single source of truth for every deal's status: commercial, legal, security, and technical via CRM
* Provide the leaders with a clear weekly view of what's moving, what's stuck, and what needs their direct involvement


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 1–3 years in a client\-facing, coordination\-heavy, or B2B support role (sales support, business operations, account management, pre\-sales, or similar) \- strong freshers with excellent communication will be considered
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English (Hindi fluency a plus for BFSI/enterprise stakeholder conversations)
* Demonstrated ownership mindset, comfortable chasing multiple internal teams without being told to
* Strong organizational skills; comfortable running trackers/spreadsheets across many parallel deals
* Professional, composed, and articulate when dealing with senior enterprise stakeholders
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Basic working understanding of APIs/integrations sufficient to coordinate (not required to write code)
* Proficiency with Google Sheets/Excel; comfort learning CRM/tracker tools quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior exposure to B2B SaaS, fintech, BFSI, or API\-first companies (internships count)
* Familiarity with enterprise procurement processes: security reviews, legal redlines, vendor onboarding
* Exposure to the lending, insurance, travel, or pension ecosystem
* Familiarity with HRIS, accounting / expense tools like Darwinbox, Keka, Greythr, Zoho, Tally, SAP, etc.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Notion, or similar
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus but not required


**What We Look For**
* Client\-first mindset: Genuinely cares whether the client had a good experience, not just whether the task got closed
* Ownership mentality: Drives things to completion with minimal supervision; treats "not my job" as not an option
* Professional \& sincere: Represents TartanHQ credibly in front of senior stakeholders at large enterprises
* Coordination discipline: Can hold 8\-10 moving threads at once without dropping any of them
* Composure under pressure: Enterprise deal cycles involve last\-minute asks and shifting timelines, stays steady through it
* Growth mindset: This function is being built from scratch; you'll help shape the playbook, not just follow one

title: Senior Associate, Tech M&A - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
**Our DTS Team Provides Following Services To Clients**
* Data \& Applied Intelligence \- Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting\-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision\-making and transform businesses.
* Product and Innovation \- Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage.
* Technology M\&A and Strategy \- Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M\&A, integrations and carve\-outs.
* Technology Transformation \- A\&M helps clients create a scalable, cost\-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities.


**How You Will Contribute**
 As a SA in the Technology M\&A team, you will lead and drive the technical evaluation, planning, and execution of IT\-focused workstreams across the M\&A lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include IT due diligence, integration planning, and separation (carve\-out) execution. You will work closely with clients (corporate or private equity), cross\-functional deal teams, and technical stakeholders to identify technology risks and value levers, recommend strategies, and deliver roadmaps for tech integration or separation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Pre\-Deal / Due Diligence**
* Lead technology due diligence for buy\-side and sell\-side engagements: assess the target’s IT organization, applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and technology maturity.
* Identify and evaluate technology risks, technical debt, hidden costs, and integration complexity.
* Develop detailed deliverables: data request lists, interview guides, agendas, architecture assessments, cost models, synergies, transition service agreement (TSA) schedules, integration or separation roadmaps.
* Estimate IT cost transformation opportunities, synergies, and post\-deal investments.
* Synthesize and present findings to executive stakeholders (both technical and business), providing actionable recommendations.
* Support the proposal process: define scope, pricing, and resource plans for prospective clients. Post\-Deal / Integration \& Separation


**Lead post\-merger IT integration or carve\-out separation programs**
* For carve\-outs, define and manage the “IT Separation Management Office”; for integrations, drive the “IT Integration Management Office” (IMO).
* Define and design the target IT operating model, including organizational structure, governance, processes, and systems alignment.
* Develop and maintain program governance artifacts: project plan, status dashboards, risk \& issue logs, resource plans.
* Lead initiative to disentangle and rationalize systems, cloud infrastructure, vendor contracts, and service delivery (outsourcing/offshoring) where relevant.
* Ensure smooth “Day 1” readiness: design day\-zero run\-rates, TSA (if any), and operating model handover.
* Mentor junior team members, providing technical and project leadership, knowledge sharing, and quality control of deliverables.

title: SAP SD Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Overview**
 Build SAP ERP technology solutions to support the Sales \& Service functions such as (Order to Cash, Sales \& Distribution, PS, MM, AR, FICO, Reporting, Master Data management etc.).
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Work with the project team, team leaders, project delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create SD (OTC) solutions powered by SAP Tools.
* Collaborate with team members across different time zones to implement regulatory solutions like e\-Invoicing across different countries like France, Spain, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, etc.
* Support bank integration for AR \& AP modules.
* Acs as SME expert to translate project requirements including features, user stories and acceptance test criteria.
* Utilizes domain knowledge to be able to effectively synthesize input from multiple stakeholders to maximize delivered value.


 Day to Day: The day to day can vary in this role, but some of the more important responsibilities and tasks to undertake can be the following, however it won’t be limited to only these:
   

  

 Sprint planning: Participate in sprint planning meetings and help define what the main priorities should be for the team in the short/medium/long term. Backlog management: Prioritize and manage SAP team backlog, ensuring that it is up to date with major user stories, bug fixes and other necessary items. This will involve refining and clarifying requirements for the development team. Stakeholder communication: Regular communication with stakeholders to gather requirements, receive feedback and communicate updates as appropriate.
   

  

 Experience \- 4 to 6 Years
   

  

**Skill And Qualifications Required**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Strong technical background, outstanding communication, presentation, time management and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage stakeholder relationships effectively, internally, and externally, and communicate to diverse stakeholders.
* Experience as SAP Consultant with at least 5 end\-to\-end SAP implementation projects.
* Proficient in all aspects of SD, including the definition and assignment of Enterprise Structure, management of Master data, Sales Order processing, and potentially integration with external systems such as SFDC, Coupa, Concur, Ariba, Mulesoft, etc.
* Sales Documents: Sales Document Header, Sales Document Item, Sales Documents, Contracts.
* Pricing: Condition table, Condition type, Access sequence, Pricing procedure, and Condition record.
* Order Management: Creation of Sales documents \- Inquiry, Quotation, Sales order (standard order, rush order, cash sales, service order, returns), Deliveries (outbound \& inbound), Billing, Invoicing, Credit memo, Debit memo; Configuration and implementation of SAP LE process, covering the complete range of functionalities like master data uploads.
* Offer expertise and comprehension of SAP Order to Cash, FICO and Purchasing principles, as well as process flows, with the ability to grasp current configurations and suggest solutions for new requirements.
